verdict.rationale: Anrok's API supports real-time tax calculation via createEphemeral for checkout previews and address resolution/normalization for rooftop-level accuracy, with rate-limit docs suggesting production readiness. missing for 10: explicit performance/latency benchmarks proving speed suitable for checkout, independent verification of rooftop-level (vs jurisdiction-level) address accuracy, and third-party/hands-on confirmation of real-time API behavior beyond vendor docs.
